subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu add an opt-in mention-only/per-bot context policy, or should the current pending group-history behavior remain the only supported model with historyLimit and groupSessionScope controls?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent answer changes public Feishu config and existing group-history semantics, so automation should not choose the default or contract name alone.

options.title: Approve Explicit Opt-In Policy
options.body: Add a Feishu plugin config such as a mention-only context policy that defaults to today’s behavior and is covered by schema, docs, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Redefine requireMention Semantics
options.body: Make requireMention also suppress pending context recording, accepting a compatibility-sensitive behavior change that needs explicit maintainer approval and upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer To Existing Controls
options.body: Keep only historyLimit, groupSessionScope, and current pending-history behavior, and document that strict per-bot context isolation is not currently supported.

recommendation.title: Approve Explicit Opt-In Policy
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu plugin config such as a mention-only context policy that defaults to today’s behavior and is covered by schema, docs, tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is specific to the Feishu/Lark plugin contract, and plugin metadata names this handle as the community maintenance owner.
